Title: Document 2
Content: Source: Jane Eltonhead, slaveholder and widow of a wealthy planter in the Maryland colony, official statement in local court, `text(1656)`.

I discharge Francis Payne, Negro, of all debts, claims or demands whatsoever, and do this day acknowledge to have received from the said Francis Payne, Negro, the sum and quantity of `3800` `text(pounds)` of tobacco. With this tobacco I received full payment of Francis Payne of Northampton, Negro, for the freedom of himself, his wife and children.
